value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Monterey/Monterey County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.name: Completed Building Permit Application (submitted via the online portal or emailed to gogreen@monterey.gov)
Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Systems Expedited Submittal Checklist, completed and signed by the owner or licensed contractor
Plans (minimum sheet size 11"x17", PDF format), including a Site Plan, Single Line Diagram, and Sheet Index
Manufacturer's Equipment Specifications/cut sheets (panels, racking, inverter, microinverter/power optimizers)
Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Detector Affidavit
Statement or engineering analysis confirming existing roof framing can support the added solar panel load (full engineering analysis required for ballasted systems)

required_documents.notes: Per the City's own 'Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Systems Expedited Submittal Checklist' (Rev. 12/30/2024), for residential solar PV systems under 10kW; condensed from the full itemized checklist.

value: Call 831-646-3890 to schedule a construction inspection no later than the business day prior to the desired inspection date, by 4:00pm
Have the permit number, job address, type of inspection needed, and requested date available when calling
Someone must be present for the inspection, and the plans and job card must be left at the site for inspector review
Inspection requests received before 2:00pm are scheduled for the next business day; requests received after 4:00pm may be scheduled for the following day
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Permit & Inspection Services construction-inspection process (covers all permit types, including solar PV building permits per the City's own Building Permit Application); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.program_or_pathway: Solar PV Expedited Submittal Checklist review, submitted via the City's Online Permit Portal (mymontereyportal.org, effective 1/7/2026) or by email
other_conditions: The expedited checklist applies to Residential Solar PV Systems under 10kW; Energy Storage System (ESS) installations use a separate ESS checklist
Permits may only be issued to the property owner or a properly licensed contractor
